note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Independent full-size read of p0/a1/p50/p100 (960x540 lite), no strip. Fact plate cyan at centre of a perspective floor ring, dimension plates as billboards with lit top and shaded side faces, back plates smaller and higher, focused front plate larger with cyan edge; Arabic shaped RTL, Latin columns in mono, no numerals, tokens only. Non-blocking: FK pulses nearly invisible in stills, wire to front plate is a ~35 px stub, no FK key labels on wires, floor ring faint, p0 empty backdrop, no parallax, orbit motion unjudged (no strip).
